create_dataset_instance: create an AirstoreBaseDataset instance with an annotation file and data prefix for image classification
get_gt_labels: get all ground-truth labels as a numpy array from the AirstoreBaseDataset
get_cat_ids: get the category id list for a given data index in the dataset
build_class_to_idx: build a class name to index mapping dictionary from the dataset CLASSES property
expanduser_path: expand tilde in a file path string using the expanduser utility function
